verdict.rationale: HubSpot's sales reporting and dashboard docs (pre-built sales reports, custom reporting dashboards, rep performance/coaching insights) imply pipeline-based reporting, but the evidence pack never explicitly mentions a forecasting tool, deal stage probability, or close-date-based revenue projection. Missing for 10: explicit forecast/deal-probability feature docs, close-date roll-up forecasting, and any hands-on or independent confirmation of forecast accuracy.
